groups.title: Look Up
groups.note: Wonder, passed from person to person. 1: two kids point up at the Atomium. 2: a grown man raises his arm to a kite between the towers. 3: a couple stands close under a needle with a giant insect on top. 4: indoors, a whole crowd tilts their heads to a painted ceiling. It starts with one child's finger and ends with everyone looking up together.

groups.title: Growing Up
groups.note: A childhood, from a held hand to riding away. 1: by the lake a man reaches down for a small child's hand. 2: at a concert a mother holds one child while another rides on shoulders. 3: two boys stand by a stranger selling paintings on a bench; the first meeting with the wider world. 4: kids climb a concrete ramp together while a girl pushes to join them. 5: a child races ahead on a scooter, the parent's bike now behind. The first three are colour, the last two B&W: childhood fading into growing up.

groups.title: Waiting for the Dance
groups.note: Loneliness, then joining in. 1: a young man sits alone on the castle lawn, looking back at people passing. 2: at night a man stands on his phone as shoppers blur past. 3: a man leans on a shutter, waiting, while the street streams by. 4: at a concert a man watches two women dance; close, but not in it. 5: on the steps, couples dance and people gather round. The city lets him in.

groups.title: Strangers to Friends
groups.note: How people come together. 1: seen from a tram, strangers wait side by side at a stop. 2: a whole street stops and gathers around bicycles fallen on the ground; strangers stopping for each other. 3: chefs throw their arms around each other while one watches alone from the balcony above. 4: old friends sit shoulder to shoulder on a bench watching bocce; a lifetime of it.

groups.title: What We're Sold
groups.note: Who works, who wants, and what's left. 1: a street sweeper pushes his barrow past glowing shop signs. 2: a model checks her luxury watch on a billboard while a man hauls cardboard below. 3: women stop at a shop window, one photographing the mannequin; the wanting starts. 4: a child drags her mother towards a giant shoe under a billboard face; it passes to the next generation. 5: a mural boy holds his face in his hands while passers-by look at their phones.

groups.title: Inheritance
groups.note: The old hand the city to the young. 1: an old woman watches a boy cross a white installation. 2: a toddler stands before a classical statue; a first meeting with the past. 3: two girls in First Communion veils pass under the castle gate; a ritual, a passage. 4: young women laugh under a bronze horseman at sunset; the city is theirs now.

groups.title: Lost and Found
groups.note: A child's walk through Design Week. 1: a man steps into a black doorway. 2: people push their heads into a porthole, searching. 3: a child crouches alone inside a black box; lost, or hiding. 4: out in the white, a boy walks between still adults. 5: among white ribbons the child stands close to a grown-up again. Dark to light, alone to held.

groups.title: Time Passes
groups.note: Three frames about time. 1: an old woman walks slowly past the Bourse. 2: another old woman passes while children play football under the arcades. 3: the children have gone; their bikes lie on the ground and pigeons fly over the square.

groups.title: The Way Out
groups.note: From confinement to freedom. 1: tiny figures squeezed into a strip of light between dark walls. 2: a lone figure stands under an arch in the rain, looking out. 3: a bird lifts off above a crowd held back behind a fence. 4: a boy spins freely in an open square under a storm sky.

groups.title: The Show
groups.note: A spectacle and the people under it. 1: a crowd pressed against railings under a giant laughing face. 2: men dwarfed beneath a towering printed figure. 3: visitors circle a yacht model in the dark. 4: a man's head peeks over a wall at a glittering chandelier. 5: in the Galleria, adults kneel to photograph while a toddler stretches in total boredom. Only the child is honest.

groups.title: Companions
groups.note: A dog's way from carried to free; it mirrors 'Growing Up'. 1: a dog's head out of a bag, seeing only legs. 2: a dog in a backpack, high up, looks straight at us. 3: on the ground beside its man, watching boys play football. 4: running and playing with its owner under the vertical forest.

groups.title: Side by Side
groups.note: Company without words, through a day. 1: two men at a lake railing, looking at the water. 2: a couple stops for a selfie by a canal. 3: people sit together in the sun outside a jazz café. 4: pairs sit along a riverbank. 5: two men rest at the base of a statue, a shoe left on the ground; the day is done.

groups.title: Small Joys
groups.note: Colour. Little private happinesses. 1: a small child walks alone beside the Como fountain. 2: a man stops by a yellow rose bush while others picnic. 3: a girl carries red and blue balloons through the crowd. 4: two women in red dance by the roadside as a truck goes past.

groups.title: Who's Watching
groups.note: The people look back. 1: eyes in a narrow slit. 2: a man waves at the camera while someone hides in the photo booth beside him. 3: a woman poses on a post under a painted woman. 4: a giant toy unicorn stares out of a shop window, straight at us.

groups.title: Unplaced
groups.note: Not in a story yet. 40 is the colour twin of 41.
